description.text: Core courses Management, Elementary Accounting, Outline of Economic Law, Marketing and Sales, Statistics, Monetary Banking, Consumer's Behavior, Financial Management, Advertising, Marketing Research, Strategic Management, Management Information System, and Sale Management Objective This objective is to train students to be middle-and-high-ranking specialized personnel who will be able to synthetically use professional marketing knowledge to analyze, plan, design or manage marketing activities to be carried out by enterprises and institutions of various types. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Management is granted.

duration.text: The Marketing and Sales at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
